title: Living with heart failure (weight, swelling, salt)
what: In heart failure the heart pumps blood more weakly. Fluid is held in the body, causing swelling and shortness of breath. Daily checks help you keep the condition under control.
why: If your doctor has found heart failure.
duration: the checks take a few minutes every day
tell_doctor: How your weight and swelling are changing
If shortness of breath has become worse or it is hard to lie down
All your medicines, including painkillers and supplements
How much fluid and salt you may have - ask your doctor

prepare.title: Scale
prepare.text: You need a scale at home. Weigh yourself every morning.

prepare.title: Diary
prepare.text: Write down your weight, blood pressure, pulse and how you feel.

prepare.title: Salt and water
prepare.text: Your doctor will tell you how much salt and fluid is allowed. Do not change it on your own.

bring: Your weight and blood pressure diary
steps: Every morning, after using the toilet and before breakfast, weigh yourself in the same clothes
Write your weight in the diary
Take your medicines every day as your doctor prescribed
Use less salt on food and avoid salty ready-made foods
Move a little every day, if your doctor allows
feel: Shortness of breath when active and tiredness are common
Water pills (diuretics) make you go to the toilet often - this is how it should be
after: If your weight rises by more than 2 kg in 2 to 3 days, call your doctor
Do not take painkillers without your doctor's advice - some hold water in the body
Ask about flu and pneumonia vaccines
red_flags: Severe shortness of breath at rest or at night, you cannot lie down - call your local emergency number
Chest pain - call your local emergency number
Fainting or a very fast heartbeat - call your local emergency number
Weight rising fast and swelling getting worse - call your doctor today

faq.q: Can I drink a lot of water?
faq.a: Not always. How much fluid you may have is for your doctor to decide.

faq.q: Why is it important to weigh myself every day?
faq.a: Weight goes up from extra water before swelling appears. It is an early warning sign.

reminders.text: Good morning! Weigh yourself before breakfast and write the number down.
